title: Sweet potato chickpea curry
summary: Sweet potato chickpea curry is a indian dinner built around sweet potatoes and canned chickpeas in water, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Sweet potato chickpea curry. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add sweet potatoes and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and canned chickpeas in water.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until chopped tomatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Sweet potato chickpea curry before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Sweet potato chickpea curry.  Check that the sweet potato is tender, then serve.
